text:
Lina H: quick FYI 450 accounts in sandbox lost healthscore seg tags after the nightly playbook refactor. Seen in renewal queue.
Arjun P: saw it too. The playbook step that copies computed tags to accounts was gated behind a feature flag that defaulted to false in prod during the deploy.
Lina H: Oof. So compute ran but write step skipped? That explains telemetry: cs.health.compute.count shows runs but cs.health.write.count is low.
Marta C: Can we run a targeted write-only reconcile for the affected cohort instead of recomputing? Prefer minimal change.
Arjun P: Agree. SQL to identify candidates:
```
SELECT id, company, health_tags
FROM accounts
WHERE health_tags IS NULL AND updated_at > now() - interval '48 hours' AND tier IN ('mid-market','enterprise');
```
Lina H: ops-bot please schedule a dry-run that writes to a staging table first and emits cs.playbook.reconcile.staging_count.
ops-bot: job 'staging-tag-write-2867009999' queued for 2026-02-14T09:00Z (dry-run). Artifacts -> s3://cs-staging/reconcile/2867009999.json
Marta C: Proposed playbook change: add a post-compute "writeback" step that's idempotent, emits metrics cs.health.writeback.attempt and .success, and has a safety abort if >1% of targets have missing primary_contact.
Arjun P: I'll open PR with small change and include a canary: 2% -> 20% -> 100% over 4h. Also include an integration test that toggles the feature flag to false/true to catch regressions.
playbook-bot: playbook 'health-writeback-v1' proposed in PR 711.
Lina H: Sandbox dry-run results: 452 rows would be written to staging, median health delta 0.00, no missing contact artifacts.
Marta C: LGTM. After canary, we'll notify CS owners for any account where tag change affects renewal routing. Lina, can you draft the owner note?
Lina H: Yep. Drafting now and will post after canary completes. Thanks all :raised_hands:
thread_summary: post-refactor missed writeback step; plan: idempotent writeback step in playbook, staging dry-run, metrics, canary rollout, owner notify
